description: Follow team/PROTOCOL.md, DELEGATION.md Common rules (docs/agent-work/2026-10-24-delegation/DELEGATION.md lines 8-20) and the approved plan docs/agent-work/2026-10-25-cheap-fixes/PLAN.md; the task section named here is the spec (files, steps, acceptance check, fail-first, stop rules). Pinned Node; serial check slot (node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/team-serial-check-slot) before expensive checks; production-preview Playwright on a free port 1500+; no installs/commits/pushes; register any extra path before editing; report CLAIMED with log paths; independent review required. Plan task T2: src-tauri/src/store.rs:174 string -> 'This project was saved by a newer version of Personal Word. Update the app to open it.'; Rust test with user_version = SCHEMA_VERSION+1; grep harness/src for consumers first; if the native harness matches the text, rebuild smoke and rerun --suite beta under the slot.

handoff.text: Stale consumer of the old text remains, so the plan's stop rule applies. scripts/native-reliability.py:1076 (beta scenario 6, beta-newer-schema) asserts: if "needs a newer version" not in report['loadError'] -> AssertionError. The new store.rs:174 string ('This project was saved by a newer version of Personal Word. Update the app to open it.') does not contain 'needs a newer version', so --suite beta will fail scenario 6 on the next smoke rebuild. The done note and team-cf2/REPORT.md claim the harness has NO match; that is false (the grep used 'newer version of', which misses this assertion). Fix: register scripts/native-reliability.py (files add), change line 1076 to match the new text (e.g. 'newer version of Personal Word'), then under the serial slot rebuild the isolated smoke binary and run python3 scripts/native-reliability.py --suite beta, expect 19 + 42 with scenario 6 'beta schema: project from a newer app version fails clearly...' passed; cite that log. What is fine: store.rs diff is only the string + new test refuses_a_database_saved_by_a_newer_version; fail-first log shows it FAILED on the old Folio text and rerun log shows 1 passed; cargo-full.log 49 passed/0 failed/1 ignored; no other src-tauri file modified after task start (only store.rs mtime 16:34 local); tests/native-reliability.js and src/ have no consumer; message is user-facing, names Personal Word, ends with a period. Reviewer did not rerun cargo (reject reason is independent of it; relied on worker logs, which I opened).
